title: Primary and conjugated bile acids (CA, CDCA, UDCA/muricholic, Gly/Tau and amino-acid conjugates) higher in surgery
meaning: Bile-acid malabsorption signature (primary and conjugated bile acids reach stool), stronger with ileocolonic resection

title: Secondary bile acids (DCA- and LCA-based) do not rise with the primary bile acids
meaning: Secondary (colon-microbial) bile acids not rising with primary ones; reduced 7-dehydroxylation is possible but not shown

title: Urobilinoids (urobilin, stercobilin) and their molecular family (F10) lower in surgery
meaning: Fewer microbial bilirubin-reduction products (urobilinoids), stronger without a colon

title: Heme/porphyrin-related features (family F13 and bilirubin/biliverdin/hemin annotations)
meaning: Heme/porphyrin features lower; direction mixed, not specific vs matched background

title: Acylcarnitines and the lauroylcarnitine family (F99) higher in surgery
meaning: Fatty-acid carnitine esters in stool, stronger without a colon

title: Lysophospholipids and glycerolipids (families F23, F156, F128) higher in surgery
meaning: Lysophospholipids and glycerolipids higher, mostly when the colon is absent

title: N-acyl amides of amino acids and amines (N-oleoyl leucine F95, N-acyl tyramines F117, N-acyl putrescines F159) higher in surgery
meaning: Microbial or host N-acyl amides higher, mostly with partial resection

title: Fatty acids and fatty-acid esters, incl. long-chain acyl lipids, higher in surgery
meaning: Fatty acids/esters modestly higher

title: Oxylipins lower in surgery
meaning: Oxylipins lower but within the general shift

title: Di- and tripeptides lower in surgery
meaning: Peptides lower, same size as the global shift

title: Amino acids, N-acetyl amino acids and indole/tryptophan metabolites lower in surgery
meaning: Amino-acid and tryptophan-pathway features lower, same size as the global shift

title: Tyr-containing conjugates lower, Phe-containing conjugates higher (opposite directions)
meaning: Tyr conjugates down, Phe conjugates up; small groups

title: Amine-carbonyl adduct families (F47, F61) from the synthetic-library annotations
meaning: Synthetic-library annotations; probably not true biology

title: Flavonoids and isoflavones (genistein/daidzein family F16, naringenin family F146) higher in surgery
meaning: Dietary flavonoids/isoflavones higher

title: Other plant/diet families (piperine F35, xanthones F49, curcuminoids F11, terpenoids)
meaning: Mixed direction; rarely detected

title: Vitamins/cofactors and steroidal alkaloids lower in surgery
meaning: Vitamin/alkaloid features lower within the general shift

title: Medication families higher in surgery (amoxicillin F37, opioids F46, sildenafil F57, pantoprazole F143, valsartan F32, mycophenolate F105, cathinone F199)
meaning: Medication or exposure families higher in surgery (opioid, antibiotic, PPI, immunosuppressant)

title: Medication families lower in surgery (PPIs F21, cetirizine F60, quinidine F31, cortisone F84, sotalol F36, trazodone F123, atorvastatin F34, quinoline F106)
meaning: Other medication families lower in surgery

title: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) series lower in surgery (families F2, F12, F42, F15, F6)
meaning: Polyethylene glycol (laxative, excipient or collection-material) signal much lower in surgery

title: Families of unannotated or putative-conjugate features lower in surgery
meaning: Unannotated and putative-conjugate families lower, many linked to bile pigments, PEG or drugs

title: Families of unannotated features higher in surgery (F83, F147, F172, F7 part)
meaning: Unannotated families higher in surgery

title: Overall lower detection and signal in surgery (all features, unannotated, singletons)
meaning: Lower overall detection in surgery (already reported as lower metabolome diversity)

title: No-surgery group: nearly all features rise over time (527 of 538 q<0.05 rise); features detected per sample jumps at 6 months in no-surgery only. Time is confounded with plate (run order vs month rho 0.73)
meaning: Plate/batch effect more likely than biology; within plates 1 to 3 the month trend is flat

title: Surgery x time interaction (16 features; 15 negative slopes) follows the same plate-confounded rise
meaning: Interaction tracks the no-surgery rise; needs a plate-adjusted model

title: Colon presence and ileocecal valve removal explain as much or more variance than has_surgery (colon_present R2 6.1% vs surgery 4.5% at baseline)
meaning: Points to anatomy (ileal loss vs colon loss) as the driver; surgery label is a proxy

title: Ileocolonic vs colectomy differ for 151 features (q<0.05): bile acids and N-acyl amides lean ileocolonic; lysophospholipids and acylcarnitines lean colectomy
meaning: Separates ileal-loss from colon-loss effects

title: Presence-only differences: 600 of 752 baseline-significant features (in the high-imputed set) differ in detection, not abundance
meaning: Detection vs true absence cannot be separated here

title: Annotated features removed by prevalence: drugs/agrochemicals 58%, contaminants 57%, diet 43%; retained-only class means understate drug and PEG effects
meaning: Unfiltered class means: PEG -0.86 vs -1.33 retained; drugs lower-group -0.78 vs -1.06

title: 37 annotated features removed by the blank filter (11 lipids, 7 contaminants, 5 drugs, 5 diet); none significant at baseline
meaning: Blank-filter losses show no surgery signal

title: 14 removed features detected in only one surgery group (11 only in no-surgery); all unannotated
meaning: Too rare to interpret

title: 703 robust unannotated MS/MS features (q<0.05, robust); 77 have an annotated neighbor (e.g. m/z 358.2599 up +3.95 next to a lauroylcarnitine-related node by C2H4)
meaning: Annotated neighbors give chemical context; identities unconfirmed

title: Cortisone-acetate-related family F84 is lower in surgery and lower in current steroid users (raw p 0.004) although steroid use is more common in surgery (29% vs 22%)
meaning: Opposite to the expected direction; needs checking

title: Annotated features shift less than detection-matched unannotated features (annotated mean log2FC -0.14 vs -0.30)
meaning: Annotation bias toward abundant, widely detected classes
